summary: Four authored Abaddon judgments unchanged: Assault HOLD, Chaos Warp HOLD, Ruinous RETAIN, Ignus PRIORITY/HOLD. PR #528 materially corrects the priority window: Grinning Ignus's sorcery-timed {R} bounce is a true mana ability, not a responseable effect on the stack. On a quiet main with priority after creature resolution it can bounce before opponent spot removal gets priority; countering creature spell, separate genuine ETB windows, Rule of Law/Drannith remain serious interactions. 8 frozen-source physical prearranged cases, 15 new and 20 predecessor tests, but no empirical opponent incidence, full 99-card interaction model or game win-rate. Canonical unaffected, M6.6/7 PARTIAL, no new M7 owner approval.
